about.title: A Clear Lake native handling the books and the taxes.
text: Matt is a Clear Lake native and a trusted tax professional serving Houston, Clear Lake, and nearby communities. With over 10 years of experience in accounting, finance and tax preparation, Matt specializes in helping Houston-area individuals, families and small business owners maximize their tax savings and simplify bookkeeping.

He earned his Bachelor's degree in Finance with Honors from Texas Tech University and has worked in accounting roles at top energy companies including Chevron, ConocoPhillips and Ineos, all headquartered in the Houston area. Matt's bookkeeping experience covers local industries such as event planning and medical practices.

As a federally licensed Enrolled Agent, Matt is authorized by the IRS to prepare taxes and provide tax advice across all 50 states. He focuses on delivering personalized, easy-to-understand tax and bookkeeping solutions to residents and businesses in Houston and Clear Lake.
When he is not helping clients, Matt enjoys camping, stand-up comedy and relaxing at Galveston beaches.
